items.name: Kansas Championship 2024
items.information:
# This is a multi-site competition in the Wichita, Kansas area
PBQ events (3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD, and FMC) will be held on Friday May 3rd at Hope Community Church in Andover, KS.
All other events will be held on Saturday May 4th and Sunday May 5th at Exploration Place in Wichita, KS. 
The venues are 16 miles apart but easily accessible via highway.

#### [TheCubicle](https://www.thecubicle.com/)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdE10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b8ac609726e60d2e6c9bce7c996d900e586223ff/cubicle-text-logo-slogan-black-trans-650x150.png)

This competition is sponsored by TheCubicle! See the Sponsor tab for more details.

***Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.***

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, ***all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, you may want to look at CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.***

venue.address: Big Oak Flat Rd, Groveland, CA 95321

items.information:
# This competition is intended to be an overnight competition/camping trip. We ask that you please only register if you intend on staying overnight. This event spans over three days (two nights).
# 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/InTentsCubingYosemite2024#27839-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
